propositions: A removal of a public-API symbol without a version/deprecation signal (major bump, deprecation cycle, or CHANGELOG breaking-change entry) must score as unversioned_published_contract_break (SERIOUS 0.9 tier) in pass-2, triggering the deletion-impact@0.60 / api-compat@0.51 gate.

The pass-2 removed-public-symbol sub-question must detect symbols reachable from the public API (__all__, re-export, CLI command, MCP tool) keyed on the EXPORT, not on presence/absence of a cited internal caller.

A deterministic boost in impact_code (serious-maint lane) applies when removed_public_symbol AND NOT version_signal_present, contributing a 0.9-tier finding that can amplify but never suppress existing scores.

The citric-preregal-ladybird false-negative (deleted rebar.llm.review_ticket scoring impact 0.30 below the 0.60/0.51 flips) must score ≥0.60 after gating + boost, with managed removals (version_signal_present: True) scoring exactly as before.
IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION must bump from code-v4 to code-v5 to segment sidecars by changed impact semantics; stale freq_mult comment in workflow_ops.py must be corrected.
Pass-2 prompt and field descriptions must explicitly name the version-signal gating rule and the export-keyed sub-question wording on both surfaces (verify_models.py, code-review-verify.md).
